hotel.name: Bel Marina Hoi An Resort
hotel.address: 127 Nguyen Phuc Tan, Minh An / Cam Pho, Hoi An (Thu Bon riverside)

tip: Dec = Central rainy season — beach/sea often rough; Cham Islands closed. Book cooking + Christmas Eve dinner early. ~4 full days (21–24) after evening arrival.

priceFamilyEst.note: free to walk streets; heritage buildings need ticket

attractions.name: Hoi An Ancient Town — evening lantern streets
attractions.shortDescription: Pedestrian lantern lanes and river reflections — the emotional core of Hoi An, free to walk.
attractions.whyKids: Treasure-hunt spotting game; colorful without tickets; repeatable short loops for 8/9/12.
attractions.reviewSummary: Hebrew + English family guides call evening lanterns the must-do. Crowds peak Christmas week.

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate: 120k adult × ~5 for 5-site ticket — under 1.3 m often free; verify live

attractions.name: Ancient Town heritage ticket (Japanese Bridge + sites)
attractions.shortDescription: 120k adult ticket covers Japanese Covered Bridge plus 4 more heritage interiors — keep to 2–3 so kids don’t fade.
attractions.whyKids: Bridge is short/photogenic; Tan Ky / Fujian Hall give story for 12yo; under ~1.3 m often free/reduced — verify.
attractions.reviewSummary: Core daytime culture loop; verify 2026 booth rules (fee-change notices floated).

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate: 150–200k VND/boat + wish lanterns small extra (~$2–3 cited) — negotiate

attractions.name: Floating lantern / Thu Bon sampan (evening)
attractions.shortDescription: 20–30 min riverside boat to release wish lanterns — magical short ride.
attractions.whyKids: All three ages love it; short enough for tired legs after Old Town walk.
attractions.reviewSummary: Good Morning Hoi An + family itineraries list as evening must.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: ~10–15 min walk to Bach Dang / riverside queue

attractions.whyKids: Ages 8–12 love tricks; 12yo still laughs. Skip/postpone in heavy rain.
attractions.reviewSummary: Hoi An Itinerary, Good Morning, Hebrew Wandering Daniel all rate as must.

attractions.name: Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary (UNESCO Cham temples)
attractions.shortDescription: Jungle Cham ruins + ~10am dance — half-day culture outing (not 4am sunrise).
attractions.whyKids: Ages 8+ fit; 12yo gets history; keep half-day to avoid temple fatigue.
attractions.reviewSummary: Strong B-tier if energy allows; pair with private car from hotel.

priceFamilyEst.note: beach free; loungers often free with food; hut/float ~50k cited — verify

attractions.name: An Bang Beach day
attractions.shortDescription: Gentle sand, beach cafés, lifeguards peak hours — Dec caveat: rough seas/rain common.
attractions.whyKids: Sandcastles + cafés; treat as weather-optional — hotel pool is backup.
attractions.reviewSummary: Family guides prefer An Bang over Cua Dai; Local Vietnam warns Dec swim often poor.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: 10–20 min Grab / hotel An Bang shuttle / bike if dry

attractions.name: Bel Marina pools + resort downtime
attractions.shortDescription: Interconnecting pool-view stay — decompress after cruise arrival and rainy afternoons.
attractions.whyKids: Included reset; Christmas morning before Da Nang move.
attractions.reviewSummary: TA ~4.9/5 · ~5,627 reviews; two pools / rooftop noted.

combos: rent kids’ bikes if needed ~30–50k/day cited

attractions.name: Hotel / countryside bicycle loops

attractions.whyKids: Ages 8–12 who can ride; skip long rides in heavy rain/mud.
attractions.reviewSummary: Good Morning + Day Trips VN love bikes; Hebrew guides too.

attractions.name: Thanh Ha Pottery Village + Terracotta Park
attractions.shortDescription: Pottery wheel / mask painting plus miniature world landmarks — tactile rainy-friendly outing.
attractions.whyKids: Ages 8–12 love wheel and painting; 2–3 hrs west of Old Town.
attractions.reviewSummary: Good Morning pottery + fee guides list as hands-on staple.
